title: Discover exact retained laboratory observation identities
description: Decoded mode-string request for the existing fortress_query tool. Returns bounded, source-bound pages of retained recording ordinals and full anchors, plus page-relevant condition_replay candidate windows. Metadata discovery requires current whole-fortress Query authority and does not scan world content, acquire observations, pin history, or establish mutation evidence.
$comment: Owning bead: df-lab-structured-query-f7q.4. Runtime rejects duplicate fields, caps this decoded UTF-8 request at 2048 bytes, admits the full retained metadata catalog before allocation and hashing (at most 4096 records), and carries the call-wide wall deadline through complete Agent Turn publication. The 85-byte lh1 cursor binds the exact recording ordinal, selected order, whole catalog, current full anchor and owning session. It is an identity checksum, not authority. Both omitted and null limit/continuation select their defaults.

limit.description: Maximum whole anchor rows. A smaller complete payload prefix may be returned. The final Agent Turn must fit losslessly or the request refuses without advancing a hidden cursor.

order.description: Retention recording order, distinct from game tick or original observation sequence.

continuation.description: Copy the opaque previous continuation and keep order unchanged; limit may change. Append, collection, re-recording, restore, changed current anchor, another session, or altered cursor invalidates it. Reading never pins retention.
